databases.name: t1d_analytics_db
databases.seed_command: PGPASSWORD="postgres" psql -h "${POSTGRES_SERVER:-127.0.0.1}" -p "${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}" -U "${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}" -d t1d_analytics_db -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_sessions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Session', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()); INSERT INTO chat_sessions (id, title) VALUES ('default-t1d-session', 'T1D Clinical Analytics Baseline Session') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, updated_at = NOW(); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t1d_cohort_metadata (table_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, min_rows INTEGER NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()); INSERT INTO t1d_cohort_metadata (table_name, min_rows, description) VALUES ('patients', 100, 'T1D clinical trial baseline cohort'), ('cgm_readings', 200, 'Continuous glucose monitoring traces'), ('hba1c_labs', 150, 'Longitudinal HbA1c and C-Peptide labs'), ('dka_adverse_events', 25, 'Diabetic ketoacidosis and severe hypoglycemia events') ON CONFLICT (table_name) DO UPDATE SET min_rows = EXCLUDED.min_rows, description = EXCLUDED.description, updated_at = NOW();"

databases.name: t1d_analytics
databases.seed_command: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; [ -f .env.secrets ] && . ./.env.secrets; set +a; export PATH="${SERVICE_PATH:-/home/${REMOTE_USER}/.local/bin:/root/.local/bin}:$PATH" && if [ ! -x t1d-analytics-backend/.venv/bin/t1d-analytics ]; then (cd t1d-analytics-backend && uv sync --python 3.12); fi && t1d-analytics-backend/.venv/bin/t1d-analytics seed --data-dir data --db "${T1D_DB_PATH:-/mnt/data/t1d_analytics.duckdb}" --sessions-db "${T1D_SESSIONS_DB_PATH:-/mnt/data/t1d_sessions.duckdb}" && t1d-analytics-backend/.venv/bin/t1d-analytics load --data-dir data --db "${T1D_DB_PATH:-/mnt/data/t1d_analytics.duckdb}"
databases.health_command: if [ ! -x t1d-analytics-backend/.venv/bin/t1d-analytics ]; then (cd t1d-analytics-backend && uv sync --python 3.12); fi && t1d-analytics-backend/.venv/bin/t1d-analytics doctor --db "${T1D_DB_PATH:-/mnt/data/t1d_analytics.duckdb}" --min-tables 4 --min-rows 400

web.build_command: set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; [ -f ../.env.secrets ] && . ../.env.secrets; set +a; export PATH="$SERVICE_PATH:$PATH" VOLTA_HOME="$VOLTA_HOME" && npm run build

pre_install.name: prepare-t1d-mount-dirs
pre_install.cmd_windows: if not exist data mkdir data

pre_install.name: ensure-t1d-block-device-mounted
pre_install.command: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; [ -f .env.secrets ] && . ./.env.secrets; set +a; if ! (mountpoint -q "${DATA_DISK_MOUNT:-/mnt/data}" 2>/dev/null || grep -qs " ${DATA_DISK_MOUNT:-/mnt/data} " /proc/mounts 2>/dev/null); then if [ -b "$PRIMARY_BLOCK_DEVICE" ]; then sudo mount "$PRIMARY_BLOCK_DEVICE" "${DATA_DISK_MOUNT:-/mnt/data}" 2>/dev/null || true; elif [ -b "$SECONDARY_BLOCK_DEVICE" ]; then sudo mount "$SECONDARY_BLOCK_DEVICE" "${DATA_DISK_MOUNT:-/mnt/data}" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi
pre_install.cmd_windows: rem Block device mounts managed by Windows Disk Management

install.name: prepare-t1d-install-dirs
install.cmd_windows: if not exist data mkdir data

install.name: install-t1d-backend-deps
install.command: set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; [ -f ../.env.secrets ] && . ../.env.secrets; set +a; export HOME="${REMOTE_HOME:-/home/${REMOTE_USER}}" UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="${REMOTE_HOME:-/home/${REMOTE_USER}}/.local/share/uv/python" UV_CACHE_DIR="${REMOTE_HOME:-/home/${REMOTE_USER}}/.cache/uv" PATH="$SERVICE_PATH:$PATH" VOLTA_HOME="$VOLTA_HOME" && _lock_hash=$(cksum uv.lock 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1"_"$2}' || printf 'none') && if [ "${FORCE_REINSTALL:-0}" != "1" ] && [ -x .venv/bin/t1d-analytics ] && [ -x .venv/bin/uvicorn ] && [ -f .venv/.libscript_lock_hash ] && [ "$(cat .venv/.libscript_lock_hash 2>/dev/null)" = "$_lock_hash" ]; then printf '[REUSE] t1d-analytics-backend .venv is up-to-date.\n'; else uv sync --python 3.12 && printf '%s\n' "$_lock_hash" > .venv/.libscript_lock_hash; fi

install.name: install-t1d-frontend-deps
install.command: set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; [ -f ../.env.secrets ] && . ../.env.secrets; set +a; export PATH="$SERVICE_PATH:$PATH" VOLTA_HOME="$VOLTA_HOME" && _pkg_hash=$(cksum package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1"_"$2}' || printf 'none') && if [ "${FORCE_REINSTALL:-0}" != "1" ] && [ -d node_modules/vite ] && [ -f node_modules/.libscript_pkg_hash ] && [ "$(cat node_modules/.libscript_pkg_hash 2>/dev/null)" = "$_pkg_hash" ]; then printf '[REUSE] t1d-analytics-web node_modules is up-to-date.\n'; else npm install && printf '%s\n' "$_pkg_hash" > node_modules/.libscript_pkg_hash; fi

post_install.name: fix-t1d-workspace-ownership
post_install.cmd_windows: rem Workspace ownership managed by Windows ACLs

db_migrate.name: prepare-t1d-data-dir
db_migrate.command: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; [ -f .env.secrets ] && . ./.env.secrets; set +a; sudo mkdir -p "${DATA_DISK_MOUNT:-/mnt/data}" data && sudo chown -R $(whoami):$(whoami) "${DATA_DISK_MOUNT:-/mnt/data}" data
db_migrate.cmd_windows: if not exist data mkdir data

db_migrate.name: upsert-and-confirm-t1d-duckdb
db_migrate.command:
set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; [ -f .env.secrets ] && . ./.env.secrets; set +a; export PATH="${SERVICE_PATH:-/home/${REMOTE_USER}/.local/bin:/root/.local/bin}:$PATH"; _db="${T1D_DB_PATH:-/mnt/data/t1d_analytics.duckdb}"; _sdb="${T1D_SESSIONS_DB_PATH:-/mnt/data/t1d_sessions.duckdb}"; _tcnt=0; if [ -f "$_db" ] && command -v duckdb >/dev/null 2>&1; then _tcnt=$(duckdb "$_db" -csv -noheader "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('information_schema', 'pg_catalog');" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' 
' || printf '0'); fi; if [ "${_tcnt:-0}" -lt 4 ] 2>/dev/null; then printf '[UPSERT:DUCKDB] Seeding and loading T1D clinical datasets into "%s"...
' "$_db" && t1d-analytics-backend/.venv/bin/t1d-analytics seed --data-dir data --db "$_db" --sessions-db "$_sdb" && t1d-analytics-backend/.venv/bin/t1d-analytics load --data-dir data --db "$_db"; fi; if command -v duckdb >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$_db" ]; then _tcnt=$(duckdb "$_db" -csv -noheader "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('information_schema', 'pg_catalog');" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' 
' || printf '0'); _sz=$(du -sh "$_db" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'); printf '[UPSERT:DUCKDB] [CONFIRM] T1D DuckDB "%s" verified (%s, %s tables); sessions DB "%s" verified.
' "$_db" "${_sz:-0B}" "${_tcnt:-0}" "$_sdb"; fi
db_migrate.cmd_windows: echo [UPSERT:DUCKDB] Verifying and upserting T1D DuckDB datasets... && t1d-analytics-backend\.venv\Scripts\t1d-analytics.exe doctor --db "%T1D_DB_PATH%" --min-tables 4 --min-rows 400 || (t1d-analytics-backend\.venv\Scripts\t1d-analytics.exe seed --data-dir data --db "%T1D_DB_PATH%" --sessions-db "%T1D_SESSIONS_DB_PATH%" && t1d-analytics-backend\.venv\Scripts\t1d-analytics.exe load --data-dir data --db "%T1D_DB_PATH%")

db_migrate.name: ensure-duckdb-permissions
db_migrate.command: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; [ -f .env.secrets ] && . ./.env.secrets; set +a; sudo chown -R "${REMOTE_USER:-ubuntu}:${REMOTE_GROUP:-ubuntu}" "${DATA_DISK_MOUNT:-/mnt/data}" data 2>/dev/null || true
db_migrate.cmd_windows: rem DuckDB permissions managed by Windows ACLs

pre_start.name: normalize-t1d-data-ownership
pre_start.command: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; [ -f .env.secrets ] && . ./.env.secrets; set +a; sudo chown -R "${REMOTE_USER:-ubuntu}:${REMOTE_GROUP:-ubuntu}" "${DATA_DISK_MOUNT:-/mnt/data}" "${TMP_DATA_DIR:-/tmp/data}" data 2>/dev/null || true
pre_start.cmd_windows: rem Data ownership managed by Windows ACLs

health.name: api-status-check
health.command: set -a && [ -f .env ] && . ./.env && set +a && curl -sf "http://127.0.0.1:${T1D_API_PORT:-8001}/api/status" | jq -e '.status == "ready" and .tables_count >= 4 and .total_rows > 0'

build.name: build-vite-web
build.command: set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; [ -f ../.env.secrets ] && . ../.env.secrets; set +a; export PATH="$SERVICE_PATH:$PATH" VOLTA_HOME="$VOLTA_HOME" && if [ "${FORCE_REBUILD:-0}" != "1" ] && [ -f dist/index.html ]; then _cnt=$(find dist -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); _sz=$(du -sh dist 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'); printf '[BUILD] [REUSE] Vite build (vite build) output verified at dist/index.html (%s files, %s; pass --force-rebuild to re-run vite build).\n' "${_cnt:-0}" "${_sz:-0B}"; else printf '[BUILD] [vite build] Building React/Vite frontend (t1d-analytics-web) -> dist/...\n' && npm run build; fi
build.cmd_windows: if not "%FORCE_REBUILD%"=="1" if exist "dist\index.html" (echo [BUILD] [REUSE] Vite build ^(vite build^) output verified at dist\index.html ^(pass --force-rebuild to re-run vite build^).) else (echo [BUILD] [vite build] Building React/Vite frontend ^(t1d-analytics-web^) -^> dist\... && npm run build)

t1d-api.command: set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; [ -f ../.env.secrets ] && . ../.env.secrets; [ -f ../.env.libscript ] && . ../.env.libscript; set +a; export PATH="${SERVICE_PATH}:/home/${REMOTE_USER}/.local/bin:/root/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv run uvicorn t1d_analytics.api:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${T1D_API_PORT:-8001}

t1d-web.command: set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; [ -f ../.env.secrets ] && . ../.env.secrets; [ -f ../.env.libscript ] && . ../.env.libscript; set +a; export PATH="${SERVICE_PATH}:/home/${REMOTE_USER}/.libscript/nodejs/22/bin:/home/${REMOTE_USER}/.libscript/nodejs/20/bin:/home/${REMOTE_USER}/.volta/bin:/root/.libscript/nodejs/22/bin:$PATH" && npx vite preview --port ${T1D_WEB_PORT:-3000} --host 0.0.0.0
